newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Lower House approves 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Lower House approves 1997 budget.

text.p: The House of Representatives said on Tuesday it approved the 476.2 billion-peso national government budget for 1997.
This is the same budget proposed by President Fidel Ramos. It is 11 percent higher than this year's 429 billion-peso budget. It targets a budget surplus of 14.7 billion pesos.
In a statement, Speaker Jose De Venecia said the 1997 budget is aimed at fighting poverty, improving infrastructure and strengthening the government workforce.
In terms of sectoral allocation, the education deparment will get the biggest amount at 69.4 billion pesos.
This is followed by national defence, 41.9 billion pesos; public works and highways, 38.0 billion pesos; local government, 26.1 billion pesos; and agriculture, 17.7 billion pesos.
De Venecia said some of the important provisions of the 1997 budget are the salary adjustment and incentive benefit package to government employees.
